description: Combining value (book-to-market) with 12-month momentum skipping the most recent month exploits the documented negative correlation between value and momentum premiums, providing diversification benefits; falsified if the composite Sharpe ratio does not exceed the higher of the standalone value or momentum strategy Sharpe ratios over the full sample period.
title: Value-Momentum Composite 252d/21d Skip · Top 30 · Top 1000 · Long Only
